column1: # Iliad - Part 2 — naskah 17 (M24017): URNC mengumumkan Commander tewas; reaksi Doll
# Community, papan anonim Griffin, Kalina, dan pidato Groza sebagai adjutant The Elmo.
# Tetap Inggris: Mayling, Suomi, Vepley, Littara, Lotta, Ullrid, Balthilde, The Elmo,
# Commander, Mokosh, Doll Community, Kalina, Shadowless, URNC, Black Zone, New Venice,
# Yellow Zone, Lviv, Griffin, Statesec, Leva, Berlin, Frankfurt, Jiangyu, Zhaohui, Faye,
# Springfield, Colphne, Krolik, Groza, Nemesis, AR Team, Mangi Security, Lentine, Lind,
# Lewis, Tokarev, Lee-Enfield, Underground Brokers, Mica Port, Master, Frame.
# Nama pengguna di papan anonim dibiarkan Inggris (nama diri).
Ah... everyone, come quick! Miss Mayling seems to have woken up!
column2: Ah... semuanya, cepat ke sini! Miss Mayling sepertinya sudah sadar!

column1: Rustle...
column2: Srek...

column1: 呼……太好了……
column2: Fyuh... syukurlah...

column1: Ah! She's awake... finally awake...!
column2: Ah! Dia sadar... akhirnya sadar...!

column1: (Where... is this?)
column2: (Ini... di mana?)

column1: (Mayling tries her best to blink. Her blurry vision keeps fluctuating, but she still tries to see her surroundings more clearly.)
column2: (Mayling berusaha sekuat tenaga mengerjap. Pandangannya yang kabur terus naik-turun, tapi dia tetap mencoba melihat sekelilingnya lebih jelas.)

column1: (First, gathered around her bedside, even though they are a bit hard to make out, she can still feel the concern overflowing from them. Without a doubt, it's the familiar Suomi and Vepley.)
column2: (Pertama, yang berkumpul di sisi tempat tidurnya, meski agak sulit dikenali, dia tetap bisa merasakan kekhawatiran yang meluap dari mereka. Tidak diragukan, itu Suomi dan Vepley yang dia kenal.)

column1: You're finally awake, everyone was very worried about you. — Littara
column2: Akhirnya kau sadar, semuanya sangat mengkhawatirkanmu. — Littara

column1: (Seeming to notice that Mayling's eyes hadn't fully recovered yet, Littara somewhat hurriedly tore a piece of paper from her notebook and carefully handed it to Mayling.)
column2: (Sepertinya menyadari mata Mayling belum sepenuhnya pulih, Littara agak buru-buru merobek selembar kertas dari buku catatannya dan menyerahkannya hati-hati kepada Mayling.)

column1: (Mayling finally saw her caring greeting clearly, and at the same time, noticed Lotta standing beside Littara, still too nervous to speak.)
column2: (Mayling akhirnya melihat jelas sapaan penuh perhatian itu, dan pada waktu yang sama menyadari Lotta berdiri di samping Littara, masih terlalu gugup untuk bicara.)

column1: (Only after Mayling gave her a somewhat weak smile did she show a relieved expression.)
column2: (Baru setelah Mayling memberinya senyum yang agak lemah, dia menampakkan wajah lega.)

column1: It's good that you're awake. I'll go notify Ullrid.
column2: Bagus kau sudah sadar. Aku akan memberi tahu Ullrid.

column1: Ah, I can do it myself...
column2: Ah, aku bisa sendiri...

column1: (Balthilde shook her head, stopping Mayling's thought of getting up.)
column2: (Balthilde menggeleng, menghentikan niat Mayling untuk bangun.)

column1: Don't worry, and don't think about getting up. Just lie down and rest.
column2: Jangan khawatir, dan jangan berpikir untuk bangun. Berbaring dan istirahat saja.

column1: I'll take on your work for you... Besides, there's nothing we can do right now anyway...
column2: Aku akan mengambil pekerjaanmu... Lagi pula sekarang tidak ada yang bisa kita lakukan...

column1: Wh... what do you mean...?
column2: A... apa maksudmu...?

column1: (Mayling felt her head was still groggy, and some fragmented memories began to gradually revive and piece together in her mind.)
column2: (Mayling merasa kepalanya masih pening, dan pecahan-pecahan ingatan mulai berangsur hidup dan menyatu di kepalanya.)

column1: Uh... sorry... I-I, I'll go get Ullrid first.
column2: Eh... maaf... a-aku, aku panggil Ullrid dulu.

column1: (After speaking unhappily, seemingly not wanting to face this atmosphere, Balthilde dragged her still somewhat incomplete frame and turned to leave.)
column2: (Setelah bicara dengan tidak senang, sepertinya tidak ingin menghadapi suasana itu, Balthilde menyeret frame-nya yang masih agak tidak lengkap dan berbalik pergi.)

column1: (Incomplete frame... work?)
column2: (Frame tidak lengkap... pekerjaan?)

column1: (Thinking of this, Mayling's consciousness felt like it was pricked by a needle, instantly waking up as tragic memories flooded back like a tidal wave.)
column2: (Berpikir sampai situ, kesadaran Mayling terasa seperti ditusuk jarum, seketika terjaga saat ingatan tragis membanjir kembali seperti pasang.)

column1: (She abruptly looks around, her gaze sweeping over every face, but she still can't find the one face she wants to see the most.)
column2: (Dia mendadak memandang sekeliling, tatapannya menyapu setiap wajah, tapi dia tetap tidak menemukan satu wajah yang paling ingin dia lihat.)

column1: (Has the Commander... not returned yet?)
column2: (Apa Commander... belum kembali?)

column1: Commander... where is the Commander?
column2: Commander... di mana Commander?

column1: Commander... has he not returned yet?
column2: Commander... dia belum kembali?

column1: (She would always blame him in her heart for not caring about her, even though she knew better than anyone that he only occasionally neglected her because he was carrying too much on his shoulders.)
column2: (Dia selalu menyalahkannya di hati karena tidak memperhatikannya, meski dia lebih tahu dari siapa pun bahwa dia hanya sesekali mengabaikannya karena memikul terlalu banyak di bahunya.)

column1: (She just wanted to throw a tantrum from time to time, wanting to receive more unique treatment and care exclusively for herself—something that wouldn't lose to the Dolls, nor to the legendary Miss Kalina.)
column2: (Dia cuma ingin sesekali merengek, ingin menerima perlakuan dan perhatian khusus yang hanya untuk dirinya—yang tidak kalah dari para Doll, maupun dari Miss Kalina yang legendaris itu.)

column1: (Because she knew that he cared about her more than anyone else, that he was more concerned about her than anyone else, so her little tantrums and awkwardness would receive the echo she hoped for.)
column2: (Karena dia tahu bahwa dia diperhatikan lebih dari siapa pun, dikhawatirkan lebih dari siapa pun, jadi rengekan dan kekikukannya yang kecil akan menerima gaung yang dia harapkan.)

column1: (—However, she had never hoped so much that, at this very moment, the reason he wasn't present was simply out of a lack of care for her.)
column2: (—Namun dia belum pernah begitu berharap bahwa saat ini, alasan dia tidak hadir semata karena kurang memperhatikannya.)

column1: No, the Commander shouldn't be in Mokosh anymore, right?
column2: Bukan, Commander seharusnya sudah tidak di Mokosh, kan?

column1: (She had already recognized that this was the medical room of the Doll Community.)
column2: (Dia sudah mengenali bahwa ini ruang medis Doll Community.)

column1: (If the Commander wasn't here, and couldn't possibly be in Mokosh, then judging from Balthilde and everyone else's hesitant behavior, there was only one possibility left...)
column2: (Kalau Commander tidak di sini, dan mustahil ada di Mokosh, maka dari sikap ragu-ragu Balthilde dan semua orang, hanya tersisa satu kemungkinan...)

column1: (The Commander hasn't successfully escaped yet.)
column2: (Commander belum berhasil keluar.)

column1: I, I don't need so many people taking care of me...
column2: A-aku tidak butuh sebanyak ini orang menjagaku...

column1: Y-You guys should go help the Commander...
column2: K-kalian seharusnya pergi membantu Commander...

column1: (The worry and unease on the Dolls' faces slowly faded at this moment, replaced by another, more gloomy emotion.)
column2: (Kekhawatiran dan kegelisahan di wajah para Doll perlahan memudar saat itu, digantikan emosi lain yang lebih kelam.)

column1: (They looked at each other, as if not knowing how to speak, or how to sort out their chaotic neural clouds.)
column2: (Mereka saling berpandangan, seolah tidak tahu harus bicara bagaimana, atau bagaimana menata neural cloud mereka yang kacau.)

column1: (Finally, the one who mustered the courage was Suomi.)
column2: (Akhirnya yang mengumpulkan keberanian adalah Suomi.)

column1: The Commander is missing...
column2: Commander hilang...

column1: (Just then, a burst of messy signal noise suddenly sounded, drowning out Suomi's timid voice.)
column2: (Tepat saat itu, semburan derau sinyal yang kacau tiba-tiba berbunyi, menelan suara Suomi yang penakut.)

column1: (The device in the room that had constantly displayed static finally lit up again. On the screen, a news anchor was broadcasting a news report.)
column2: (Perangkat di ruangan yang terus menampilkan derau itu akhirnya menyala kembali. Di layarnya, seorang pembawa berita sedang menyiarkan laporan.)

column1: Frontline news flash from this station.
column2: Kabar kilat garis depan dari stasiun kami.

column1: This station's senior reporter, Shadowless, has currently arrived near the blockade zone.
column2: Reporter senior stasiun kami, Shadowless, saat ini sudah sampai di dekat zona blokade.

column1: Ms. Shadowless, thank you for returning to the front lines to host. May I ask what the current situation is in the blockade zone?
column2: Ms. Shadowless, terima kasih sudah kembali ke garis depan untuk memandu. Bagaimana situasi terkini di zona blokade?

column1: (The wind blew against Shadowless's frail body. In the empty, deserted wilderness, even a slight sway from her looked incredibly worrying on the broadcast.)
column2: (Angin menerpa tubuh Shadowless yang ringkih. Di belantara yang kosong dan terbengkalai itu, goyangan kecilnya saja terlihat sangat mengkhawatirkan di siaran.)

column1: Hello, anchor.
column2: Halo, pembawa acara.

column1: As everyone can see, after the end of this turmoil, due to the environmental impact of the military means employed by both sides.
column2: Seperti yang bisa dilihat semuanya, setelah kekacauan ini berakhir, karena dampak lingkungan dari cara militer yang dipakai kedua pihak.

column1: The northern part of Mokosh has suffered severe contamination. Currently, the relevant URNC departments have designated this area as the highest-level 'Class S Blockade Zone', with a hazard level even higher than the Black Zone...
column2: Bagian utara Mokosh mengalami kontaminasi berat. Saat ini departemen terkait URNC sudah menetapkan area itu sebagai 'Class S Blockade Zone' tingkat tertinggi, dengan tingkat bahaya bahkan lebih tinggi dari Black Zone...

column1: ...It must be specially emphasized to all citizens watching this report that both entering and observing this area are prohibited.
column2: ...Perlu ditekankan khusus kepada semua warga yang menonton laporan ini bahwa memasuki maupun mengamati area itu sama-sama dilarang.

column1: A week has passed since the incident occurred. Relevant personnel have attempted to take measures, but even simple observation still causes severe, large-scale casualties. The specific reasons are still under investigation by the URNC.
column2: Sudah seminggu sejak insiden itu terjadi. Personel terkait sudah mencoba mengambil langkah, tapi pengamatan sederhana saja tetap menimbulkan korban berat dalam skala besar. Alasan spesifiknya masih diselidiki URNC.

column1: Residents, please also pay attention to the blockade zone and do not rashly approach or observe it.
column2: Warga juga mohon memperhatikan zona blokade itu dan tidak gegabah mendekat atau mengamatinya.

column1: I will continue to station within a safe range and transmit frontline intelligence back to everyone at any time—
column2: Saya akan terus bersiaga dalam jarak yang aman dan mengirimkan intel garis depan kembali kepada semuanya kapan saja—

column1: Please wait a moment, Ms. Shadowless.
column2: Mohon tunggu sebentar, Ms. Shadowless.

column1: Regarding this unprecedented disaster... what the general public is most concerned about is: is the culprit who triggered this lockdown still that URNC wanted criminal—the "Commander"?
column2: Soal bencana yang belum pernah terjadi ini... yang paling dipedulikan masyarakat adalah: apakah pelaku yang memicu penutupan ini tetap kriminal yang dicari URNC itu—"Commander"?

column1: ...Currently, there is no evidence to draw this conclusion.
column2: ...Saat ini tidak ada bukti untuk menarik kesimpulan itu.

column1: Rumor has it that his whereabouts are still unknown. May I ask if the troops stationed in Mokosh have any indirect evidence proving that he is hiding in Mokosh?
column2: Kabarnya keberadaannya masih tidak diketahui. Apakah pasukan yang bertugas di Mokosh punya bukti tidak langsung yang membuktikan dia bersembunyi di Mokosh?

column1: Or is it possible that he has already perished in this disaster that he himself caused...
column2: Atau mungkinkah dia sudah musnah dalam bencana yang dia sebabkan sendiri...

column1: The specific situation cannot be confirmed yet.
column2: Situasi spesifiknya belum bisa dipastikan.

column1: —But I believe that all the current accusations against the one named 'Commander' have some degree of falsehood.
column2: —Tapi saya yakin semua tuduhan yang sekarang diarahkan pada orang bernama 'Commander' itu mengandung kepalsuan sampai tingkat tertentu.

column1: The victims of the New Venice tragedy are barely cold in their graves.
column2: Korban tragedi New Venice bahkan belum dingin di kuburnya.

column1: Yet during this time, the URNC Parliament passed the 'P.M.C. Armed Firepower Act' with an unreasonably high efficiency, and immediately authorized private armed forces to launch a so-called 'strike and cleanup' in the Yellow Zone.
column2: Tapi dalam waktu itu, Parlemen URNC meloloskan 'P.M.C. Armed Firepower Act' dengan efisiensi yang tidak wajar tingginya, lalu langsung memberi wewenang kepada pasukan bersenjata swasta untuk melancarkan apa yang mereka sebut 'penindakan dan pembersihan' di Yellow Zone.

column1: I would like to ask all the higher-ups involved in pushing the bill—did the rapid implementation of this bill involve the individual interests of certain financial conglomerates?
column2: Saya ingin bertanya kepada semua kalangan atas yang terlibat mendorong rancangan itu—apakah cepatnya pemberlakuan rancangan ini melibatkan kepentingan pribadi konglomerat finansial tertentu?

column1: If not, then why was the thorough investigation and accountability for the New Venice City tragedy secretly shelved? Why did it have to give way to this blatant arms expansion—
column2: Kalau tidak, kenapa penyelidikan menyeluruh dan pertanggungjawaban tragedi Kota New Venice diam-diam dipeti-eskan? Kenapa itu harus mengalah pada ekspansi persenjataan yang terang-terangan ini—

column1: (The broadcast signal is forcibly cut off.)
column2: (Sinyal siarannya diputus paksa.)

column1: (Shadowless's unspoken words get stuck in her mouth, but she seems to have expected this outcome long ago. She restores her usual plain expression and casually brushes her wind-messed hair.)
column2: (Kata-kata Shadowless yang belum terucap tersangkut di mulutnya, tapi dia sepertinya sudah lama menduga hasil itu. Dia memulihkan ekspresi datarnya yang biasa dan sekenanya merapikan rambutnya yang diacak angin.)

column1: (...It's been ten years.)
column2: (...Sudah sepuluh tahun.)

column1: (She never thought there would actually be a chance to hear this name again, to see... that person.)
column2: (Dia tidak pernah menyangka akan ada kesempatan mendengar nama itu lagi, melihat... orang itu.)

column1: (Although no one mentioned it, and it was highly likely no one would believe it, she was very certain—it was him, it had to be him.)
column2: (Meski tidak ada yang menyebutnya, dan sangat mungkin tidak ada yang mau percaya, dia sangat yakin—itu dia, pasti dia.)

column1: (That person who, ten years ago in that livestream, used sonorous and forceful words to ignite a fire for Frankfurt and for herself.)
column2: (Orang yang sepuluh tahun lalu di siaran langsung itu memakai kata-kata yang lantang dan bertenaga untuk menyalakan api bagi Frankfurt dan bagi dirinya sendiri.)

column1: (...Of course, no one would mention it.)
column2: (...Tentu saja, tidak ada yang mau menyebutnya.)

column1: (That livestream, today, cannot be found with even the slightest trace on any channel, anywhere.)
column2: (Siaran langsung itu, hari ini, tidak bisa ditemukan sedikit pun jejaknya di kanal mana pun, di mana pun.)

column1: (It's as if it never existed.)
column2: (Seolah itu tidak pernah ada.)

column1: (At first, she thought this was a punishment for her reckless behavior back then—until later, she realized she was just the most insignificant link in it all.)
column2: (Awalnya dia mengira itu hukuman atas kelakuan gegabahnya dulu—sampai kemudian dia menyadari dia hanya mata rantai yang paling tidak berarti dalam semuanya.)

column1: ...At least, you haven't changed a bit.
column2: ...Setidaknya, kau sedikit pun tidak berubah.

column1: Fortunately, neither have I.
column2: Untungnya, aku juga tidak.

column1: (The news anchor somewhat frantically switched the signal back to the studio feed, forcing a smile as they continued the previous topic.)
column2: (Pembawa berita itu agak panik mengalihkan sinyalnya kembali ke studio, memaksakan senyum sembari melanjutkan topik sebelumnya.)

column1: O-Okay, thank you for the news, Shadowless. We will continue to follow up on intelligence regarding the restricted zone.
column2: B-baik, terima kasih atas beritanya, Shadowless. Kami akan terus menindaklanjuti intel mengenai zona terlarang itu.

column1: Just now, that was...
column2: Tadi itu...

column1: (Mayling hazily begins to become aware of this.)
column2: (Mayling mulai samar-samar menyadarinya.)

column1: (That might be a power from a higher dimension, not belonging to this world, a door leading to the unknown and truth, crossing time and space.)
column2: (Itu mungkin kekuatan dari dimensi yang lebih tinggi, bukan milik dunia ini, sebuah pintu menuju ketidaktahuan dan kebenaran, yang melintasi ruang dan waktu.)

column1: (But if that's the case, the Commander might be on the other side of the door, waiting for her...)
column2: (Tapi kalau begitu, Commander mungkin ada di sisi lain pintu itu, menunggunya...)

column1: (Thinking of this, the unease in Mayling's heart was slightly diluted.)
column2: (Berpikir sampai situ, kegelisahan di hati Mayling sedikit mengencer.)

column1: (But the news broadcast did not stop. The anchor seemed to receive a communication and was confirming it with the director off-screen.)
column2: (Tapi siaran beritanya tidak berhenti. Pembawa acaranya sepertinya menerima komunikasi dan sedang memastikannya dengan pengarah acara di luar layar.)

column1: Eh? Are you s-sure? Just now... Okay, okay, I understand...
column2: Eh? A-anda yakin? Tadi... Baik, baik, saya mengerti...

column1: Viewers, we interrupt this broadcast for the latest official announcement just released by the URNC government.
column2: Pemirsa, kami menyela siaran ini untuk pengumuman resmi terbaru yang baru dirilis pemerintah URNC.

column1: The investigation into the armed rebellion in Mokosh has concluded, and the URNC has released information on the relevant criminals.
column2: Penyelidikan pemberontakan bersenjata di Mokosh sudah selesai, dan URNC merilis informasi mengenai para kriminal terkait.

column1: The culprit behind this Mokosh rebellion has been confirmed to be the same person as the terrorist in the previous severe violent incident in Lviv.
column2: Dalang pemberontakan Mokosh ini dipastikan orang yang sama dengan teroris dalam insiden kekerasan berat di Lviv sebelumnya.

column1: It is reported that the wanted criminal 'Commander' was killed in this incident.
column2: Dilaporkan bahwa kriminal yang dicari, 'Commander', tewas dalam insiden ini.

column1: In three days, the new Mayor of Mokosh will deliver their inaugural declaration.
column2: Tiga hari lagi, Wali Kota Mokosh yang baru akan menyampaikan deklarasi pelantikannya.

column1: (Ullrid, who had just stepped into the ward, heard this news that was like a bolt from the blue.)
column2: (Ullrid yang baru melangkah masuk ke bangsal mendengar berita yang seperti guntur di siang bolong itu.)

column1: (Everyone in the room raised their heads in unison, looking at the images on the TV.)
column2: (Semua orang di ruangan mengangkat kepala serentak, menatap gambar di TV.)

column1: The Commander... was...
column2: Commander... sudah...

column1: Killed...?
column2: Tewas...?

column1: (Snap!)
column2: (Krak!)

column1: (A crisp cracking sound.)
column2: (Satu bunyi patah yang nyaring.)

column1: (The fountain pen in Littara's hand is forcefully snapped in two by her, and the glaring ink splatters onto her palm.)
column2: (Pena di tangan Littara dipatahkan jadi dua olehnya, dan tinta yang mencolok itu menyemprot ke telapak tangannya.)

column1: (But she seems to have lost her ability to speak, unable to utter a single word.)
column2: (Tapi dia seolah kehilangan kemampuan bicaranya, tidak sanggup mengeluarkan satu kata pun.)

column1: Commander... was the TV just talking about the Commander...
column2: Commander... TV tadi bicara soal Commander...

column1: Didn't everyone say the Commander would...
column2: Bukannya semuanya bilang Commander akan...

column1: Eh? Why can't Vepley see clearly... Emotion module error? Eh...
column2: Eh? Kenapa Vepley tidak bisa melihat jelas... Galat modul emosi? Eh...

column1: Why...
column2: Kenapa...

column1: (The Dolls' exclamations filled the entire room, but Mayling couldn't hear anything anymore.)
column2: (Seruan para Doll memenuhi seluruh ruangan, tapi Mayling tidak bisa mendengar apa pun lagi.)

column1: (The Commander... is dead?)
column2: (Commander... mati?)

column1: (That sliver of hope that had just risen in her heart was extinguished as if a basin of ice water had been poured over her head.)
column2: (Setitik harapan yang baru naik di hatinya padam seperti disiram sebaskom air es di atas kepalanya.)

column1: (Regardless of what the truth was, the moment she heard those words, Mayling felt the world spin, and the world before her eyes was quickly swallowed by endless darkness.)
column2: (Apa pun kebenarannya, begitu mendengar kata-kata itu, Mayling merasa dunia berputar, dan dunia di depan matanya cepat ditelan kegelapan tanpa ujung.)

column1: (On the Griffin anonymous message board, the screen was already flooded with all kinds of information.)
column2: (Di papan pesan anonim Griffin, layarnya sudah dibanjiri segala macam informasi.)

column1:

<color=#f26c1c>Don't Call Me Grease Gun:</color> I don't believe it! Does anyone on the frontline have any new information!
<color=#f26c1c>Hidden Secret Weapon:</color> Give me coordinates, I'll be there right away!
<color=#f26c1c>Divination Channel - Yelena:</color> I've already contacted colleagues at the TV station. It seems this news was suddenly issued from above to be broadcast uniformly across all stations.
<color=#f26c1c>Divination Channel - Yelena:</color> But as for the news content itself... I think there are many suspicious points.
<color=#f26c1c>Please Give Me a Blood Pack:</color> Our squad will immediately head to Mokosh to confirm the situation.

<color=#f26c1c>Flying Lion:</color> We still have a victory we haven't presented to him yet!
<color=#f26c1c>Mountain Eagle:</color> The Commander's vitality is just like my sister's head.
<color=#f26c1c>Mountain Eagle:</color> Although it's always very weak, it will ultimately never disappear.
<color=#f26c1c>Mountain Eagle:</color> We are going to confirm it right now.

<color=#f26c1c>Don't Call Me Grease Gun:</color> Ada apa? Beritanya benar?
<color=#f26c1c>Don't Call Me Grease Gun:</color> Aku tidak percaya! Ada yang di garis depan punya informasi baru?
<color=#f26c1c>Hidden Secret Weapon:</color> Beri aku koordinatnya, aku akan segera ke sana!
